job.title: Field Application Scientist
job.description:

This role sits at the intersection of biophysics, biomolecular interactions and customer-facing science. 

Responsibilities:

  • Run customer demonstrations and feasibility studies from a San Francisco applications lab
  • Work with scientists to understand assay goals, experimental design and success criteria
  • Support applications involving biomolecular interactions, binding assays and biophysical characterization
  • Present technical results and demo findings clearly to customers
  • Support pre-sales scientific discussions alongside the commercial team
  • Lead installations, training, troubleshooting and post-sale applications support
  • Feed customer insight back into the scientific and product teams
  • Support a territory covering Southern California and the Southwest

job.title: Director and Research and Development
job.description:
Director of R&D – Nucleic Acid Technologies

Our client is seeking an experienced Director of Research & Development to lead the development, scale-up, and commercialization of advanced nucleic acid-based products, with a focus on DNA and RNA technologies.

This is a senior leadership role for a scientifically rigorous, commercially minded R&D leader who can take products from concept through development, transfer, and launch. The successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise in molecular biology or related fields, strong experience in regulated life sciences environments, and a proven ability to lead cross-functional programs involving R&D, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and commercial teams.

The Role

As Director of R&D, you will lead application and product development initiatives across nucleic acid technologies. You will oversee scientific strategy, experimental design, product optimization, scale-up, and technology transfer, ensuring that innovation is aligned with business goals, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and manufacturing realities.

You will also build and mentor a high-performing R&D team, creating a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and practical execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead R&D programs focused on nucleic acid technologies, including DNA and RNA applications.

  • Drive application and product development from early-stage concept through commercialization.

  • Oversee experimental design, data analysis, interpretation, and technical decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and commercial teams to transition products from R&D into production.

  • Guide process scale-up and technology transfer, optimizing for quality, efficiency, cost, and manufacturability.

  • Ensure products, processes, and documentation comply with relevant ISO standards and quality systems.

  • Maintain strong documentation practices, including SOPs, technical reports, development records, and regulatory support materials.

  • Lead multiple concurrent projects while meeting demanding product development and launch timelines.

  • Monitor scientific, technical, and market trends to identify new opportunities in nucleic acid-based technologies.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a capable R&D team, fostering innovation, ownership, and high standards.

Required Experience

  • PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or a related life sciences discipline.

  • Minimum of 10 years’ relevant industry experience in biological R&D.

  • Proven expertise in nucleic acid technologies, including DNA and RNA product development and applications.

  • Strong track record in application development, product development, and commercialization.

  • Experience leading complex R&D programs and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in regulated life sciences environments, such as diagnostics, therapeutics, biotechnology, or related fields.

  • Successful track record of launching nucleic acid-based products.

  • Experience working in cleanroom environments, including contamination control, aseptic techniques, and environmental monitoring.

  • Knowledge of ISO standards and quality systems, including ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and cleanroom classifications such as ISO Class 5–8.

  • Hands-on experience with manufacturing processes, scale-up, and production transfer.

  • Familiarity with automation, high-throughput systems, or bioinformatics tools.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior R&D leader who combines scientific depth with commercial pragmatism. You will be comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels, able to set direction while still understanding the details that determine whether a product can be successfully developed, manufactured, and launched.

You will bring structure, pace, and scientific discipline to complex development programs, while helping build an R&D function capable of delivering high-quality, market-ready products.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to take a leading role in the development of innovative nucleic acid-based technologies, working at the intersection of scientific innovation, product development, manufacturing, and commercialization.

For an experienced R&D leader looking to shape product strategy, build high-performing teams, and bring advanced DNA and RNA technologies to market, this role offers significant scope, visibility, and impact.

job.title: Principal Scientist
job.description:
Senior / Principal Scientist – Genomics Sample Preparation

Step into scientific ownership.

Our client is a growing life sciences company developing products used in genomics sample preparation, nucleic acid purification, and DNA/RNA workflow applications.

They are looking for a technically strong scientist who can help build out their internal genomics and nucleic acid sample prep capability.

This is not a routine bench role.

It is a high-ownership opportunity for someone who has helped develop real molecular biology, genomics, sample prep, purification, assay, or workflow products in industry — and now wants greater influence, visibility, and responsibility.

You may currently be a Principal Scientist, Senior Scientist, Senior Principal Scientist, Staff Scientist, Technical Lead, Senior Manager, or Associate Director.

The title attached to this opportunity is less important than the work itself: helping shape a growing product range in nucleic acid sample preparation and becoming a key scientific authority within the business.

The Opportunity

The company has strong product development and manufacturing foundations, but is now expanding further into genomics and nucleic acid workflow products.

They need someone who understands the science deeply enough to guide product development, troubleshoot complex technical problems, and help translate molecular biology workflows into robust, manufacturable products.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, quality, and commercial teams to help develop and scale products used in DNA/RNA workflows, sample preparation, extraction, cleanup, purification, and related genomics applications.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys being close to the science, but wants to move beyond being an individual contributor.

What You Will Work On

  • Development of nucleic acid sample preparation products and workflows.

  • DNA/RNA extraction, purification, cleanup, and related molecular biology applications.

  • Genomics workflow development, including automation-compatible methods.

  • Product optimization, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving.

  • Experimental design, data analysis, documentation, and technical decision-making.

  • Transfer of products and processes from R&D toward manufacturing.

  • Collaboration with manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and commercial teams.

  • Development of practical, reliable, scalable products rather than purely academic methods.

  • Support for product launch, customer use, and continuous product improvement.

  • Mentoring or guiding junior scientists as the function grows.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Nucleic acid sample preparation

  • DNA extraction or RNA extraction

  • DNA/RNA purification

  • PCR cleanup

  • NGS library preparation

  • Molecular biology workflow development

  • Genomics applications

  • Magnetic bead, silica, solid-phase, or related purification technologies

  • Sample prep kits, reagents, consumables, or workflow products

  • Automation-compatible molecular biology workflows

  • Liquid handling, high-throughput sample prep, or method development

The ideal person will have worked on products, applications, workflows, kits, reagents, or consumables that needed to function reliably outside a research-only setting.

Background That Would Fit Well

Relevant backgrounds may include:

  • Life science tools

  • Sample preparation

  • Nucleic acid purification

  • Molecular diagnostics

  • Genomics tools

  • NGS workflow development

  • PCR/qPCR applications

  • Research-use reagents or consumables

  • Automation-compatible sample prep

  • Molecular biology product development

You do not need to have already held a large Director-level role.

You do need to have led technical work, influenced projects, solved difficult scientific problems, and understand how product development differs from academic research.

Valuable Experience

Experience with any of the following would be highly relevant:

  • Product development or application development in industry

  • Scale-up or transfer into manufacturing

  • Working with quality, manufacturing, or regulatory teams

  • ISO 13485, ISO 9001, GMP, or other quality-driven environments

  • Cleanroom, contamination control, or controlled manufacturing settings

  • Automation platforms such as Hamilton, Tecan, Agilent, INTEGRA, Beckman, or similar systems

  • Supporting customer-facing applications or troubleshooting

  • Leading projects or mentoring other scientists

The Person Who Will Thrive

This role is for someone who wants more ownership.

You may be the person currently doing the technical heavy lifting behind a product, workflow, or application, while someone else owns the strategy.

This opportunity offers the chance to become the scientific voice in the room.

The right person will be practical, curious, fast-moving, and commercially aware. They will care about good science, but also understand that good products must be reliable, scalable, documented, manufacturable, and useful to customers.

Why This Role Is Different

Many scientific roles offer depth without influence.

This role offers the chance to help build a capability.

You will have visibility, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape how a growing company develops its genomics and nucleic acid sample prep product range.

For a strong technical scientist ready to step into broader ownership, this is a chance to move from contributing to the roadmap to helping define it.
